records.title: From Optimism to Concern: Unveiling Sentiments and Perceptions Surrounding ChatGPT on Twitter
records.reason: The work studies public sentiment toward ChatGPT on Twitter, not model inference/serving.

records.title: Efficient Solutions For An Intriguing Failure of LLMs: Long Context Window Does Not Mean LLMs Can Analyze Long Sequences Flawlessly
records.reason: This paper studies long-context reasoning failures and analysis quality, not an efficiency intervention.

records.title: Mixture of Low-rank Experts for Transferable AI-Generated Image Detection
records.reason: The method detects AI-generated images using low-rank experts; it is not LLM inference/serving.

records.title: Turning Dust into Gold: Distilling Complex Reasoning Capabilities from LLMs by Leveraging Negative Data
records.reason: Smaller-model distillation may lower inference cost, but the paper’s inspected results focus on training/distillation and reasoning quality without matched serving-efficiency measurements.

records.title: Unified Data-Free Compression: Pruning and Quantization without Fine-Tuning
records.reason: Primary text confirms the pruning and quantization techniques target CNN/image-classification architectures, not LLM inference.
